description: This file defines the internal class MembershipAgent, responsible for managing silo membership status updates, health checks, and lifecycle participation within the Orleans cluster runtime. It includes methods for becoming active, joining, shutting down, and updating liveness information, as well as lifecycle integration and logging.

classes.name: MembershipAgent
classes.description: An internal class responsible for managing cluster membership state, updating liveness info, validating connectivity, and participating in the lifecycle of silos in Orleans.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Periodically updates the IAmAlive timestamp in the membership table, with exponential backoff on failures.

methods.name: BecomeActive
methods.description: Transitions the silo status to active after validating initial connectivity.

methods.name: ValidateInitialConnectivity
methods.description: Ensures connectivity with other silos before fully joining the cluster.

methods.name: CheckClusterConnectivity
methods.description: Sends ping requests to active silos to check their responsiveness.

methods.name: BecomeJoining
methods.description: Transitional state to indicate a silo is in the process of joining the cluster.

methods.name: BecomeShuttingDown
methods.description: Transitions the silo to a shutting down state.

methods.name: BecomeStopping
methods.description: Transitions the silo to stopping state.

methods.name: BecomeDead
methods.description: Marks the silo as dead in the membership table.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the silo's status in the membership table.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Method implementing IOC lifecycle to initialize and shut down the membership agent.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources used by the membership agent.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Evaluates the health status of the membership agent based on liveness.
